fact: The National Institute of Health reports, on national data for 2018-2024, that death registration rose from 29 to 46 per cent as SIS-COVE community data were integrated with e-SIRCEV, expanded from 2 to 9 districts.
title: Integration of SIS-COVE and CRVS in Mozambique
publisher: National Institute of Health, Mozambique (Milton Sengo)
